known.title: The repair adds plan-manager/SKILL.md to the Files cell of step 3 but not of step 6, which ships the same contract change and refreshes the content hashes
known.locator: Steps, row 6 ship_prompt, Files (line 73); Steps, row 3 candidates, Files (line 70); Research, Decisions 7 (line 48); Research, Engineering standards (line 61)
known.summary: The round-2 finding named the Files cells of steps 3 and 6. The repair adds plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/plan-manager/SKILL.md to step 3 only. Step 6 ships plan-contract.md when the winner changed it, and it refreshes the content hashes. The hash of plan-manager/SKILL.md covers its references/*.md (scripts/skills/content-hash.mjs, line 5 at repo_ref), and the backfill rewrites its updated and content_hash fields (plan-manager/SKILL.md, lines 7-8). So step 6 must edit a file that its Files cell does not name, or it skips the backfill and the content-hash check of the plugin gate fails (scripts/ci.mjs, line 573).
